english:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Radiolaria Breach'. You cannot regain Radiolaria Breach until you have healed back to full HP.

Reaching Critical Health consumes Radiolaria Breach and triggers the following effects:
• An explosion that deals up to <pve 360 /> <pvp [11] /> damage in a 7 meter radius
• 50 to your Health stat for 7.5 seconds
• 4 Radiolaria Pools spawned 5 meters away from you, each dealing <pve 14 /> <pvp [?] /> <arc Arc /> damage every 0.5 seconds

source.text:
2 Piece | Radiolaria Breach

On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Radiolaria Breach.
Can only trigger once per Full Heal.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Radiolaria Breach to trigger an explosion that deals up to 360 [11] Damage over 7 meters.
+50 Health Stat for 7.5 seconds and releases 4 Radiolaria Pools 5 meters away from the user.
Radiolaria Pools deal 14 Arc Damage every 0.5 seconds.
